BE NOT DISSUADED BY OTHERS!
Do not listen to those among us who would have cou believe that

collapse or the vital organs of the circulation system to be dis-
lodged. Heed not those that describe passersby who were allegedly
crazed and caused to run amuck at the mere sight of this moving

ABOUT OX COMPANY.
Our headquarters is the only one of its kind in the San Francisco
Bay Area where we direct scheduled aero transport journeys
to cities in the western territory of the United States of America
and Mexico and Canada. Our aeromachines are constructed
of the finest aluminum
wonder metal that is backed up

sturdy steel. Our Captains are registered with the United States
Government. All of our journeys are under strict direction. Any
legitimate bank can verify our financial condition.
Be assured that your trade will be appreciated.
SAFE, SWIFT SURE
AERO TRANSPORT
ADVANCE GUARD OF CIVILIZATION.
Rise like a bird over other forms of transport at speeds

luxury. We guarantee complete satistaction and reli-
ability: Send today for our big catalogue free. We have
cheap prices and many places to travel. All custeners
are treated alike.
A TRAINED EMPLOYEE ALWAYS IN ATTENDANCE.
Our alert attendants are at your beck and call for the
soothing of the human psyche. Each has heen meticu-
lously trained to. aid the
discomforted. On special
journeys, we serve good, nourishing food to refresh you
during your voyage aloft. We offer all manner of things
for the mere price of admission. Plus you will see sights
never before witnessed by man or beast through special
viewing ports on the sides of this miraculous muchine.
WHAT OTHER PEOPLE SAY OF AERO TRAVEL:
• PLAIN TALK FOR YOUR BENEFIT.
"Reluctantly I tried your new transport. It was very good and
safe. I reached my homestead quicker than my friend who took
the stage. My baggage and tools in your freight section aise arrived

Tracy Hornbuckle
Entiat, Washington
